subject: release-tooling/workspace-local-preflight
statement: Release and recovery preflights must preserve Agent DevTools canonical workspace-local semantics. Raw Git scans must not reinterpret `devtools/agent/`, `.agent-work/`, `.agent-cache/`, `.agent-bootstrap-report.json`, or known transient publisher files as material project changes.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Dogfood Agent DevTools by converting proven R6/R6.1 release and recovery failure lessons into durable project knowledge.
